title: Meet Confirm — payload
description: The opener confirms an accepted meeting; the guide appends one meet edge naming both marks. The response ($defs.Response) is the appended link.

code.description: The meeting code shown at open: five characters from the guide's unambiguous alphabet, lowercase.

mark.description: The opener's mark; equal to the document's issuer before joining.

Response.description: The meet link on the guide's chain.

seq.description: The link's sequence number on the guide's chain.

hash.description: The link's hash, folding the previous link's hash.
